in_hebrew.name: Gatias
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gatias הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Gatas', meaning 'joyful' and 'gift'. In Greek mythology, Gatas was a goddess of joy and merriment. In Christianity, this name is given to a child born as a gift and source of joy.

in_greek.name: Γατιας
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'gatēs', meaning 'guest', 'stranger', or 'foreigner'. The suffix '-ias' is added to indicate a person. Thus, 'Gatias' could be interpreted as 'Follower of God' or 'Stranger to God'.

in_latin.name: Gatias
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Joyful Gift
in_latin.long_meaning: Gatias est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name 'Gatas', meaning 'joyful' and 'gift'. In Greek mythology, Gatas was a goddess of joy and merriment. In Christianity, this name is given to a child born as a gift and source of joy.
